scope: Fresh query validation of a frozen bounded 66-entry reconstruction on familiar target families; not full-catalog release or new-algorithm generalization.
candidate: Same frozen contradiction-only policy, encoder, 66 entries, vectors, thresholds, 16-source approval and four-thread CPU budget; no result-driven change.
authorship: Two explicitly authorized isolated author/reviewer agents with no developer history, results, developer queries or solutions. Foundation-model prior exposure unknown; not human evidence.
author_input: Only author_catalog.json identity/title/tag/difficulty metadata for the 16 qualified sources. Do not expose source wording, dev queries, code or route outcomes.
reviewer_input: Authored cases and reviewer_sources.json indexed requirements; no candidate results or solutions. Validate independent expected outputs and material ambiguity before sealing. Retain rejected and revised cases.
population_limits: No new naturally absent-algorithm claim is possible from this reduced catalog. Do not manufacture absence by selecting an excluded or unapproved known source. The historical original description cohort remains sealed and absent locally.
public_inputs: Exactly the initially authored text/examples/output semantics. No evaluator target, oracle signature, requirements labels, private checks or clarification enters the route. Material ambiguity requires abstention, including if one sibling happens to pass examples.
freeze: Freeze implemented evaluator and verify every original serving-file hash before loading newly authored contents. Bind authored/reviewed/disposition files, catalog/exclusions, candidate, dependencies and budgets. One opening; atomic resumable decisions and scoring. Seal all public decisions before private checks.
qualification: Report first-attempt returned-correct/wrong/unqualified, abstentions, top-five availability, zero questions, family/kind coverage and complete startup/route/scoring costs. Preserve defects/rejections in the planned denominator. No tuning afterward.
acceptance: No replacement release gate. Existing full-catalog 1a 18/20 + zero-wrong + 4/4 absence gate remains unchanged and is not satisfied by this bounded, no-absence sample. 1b has no agreed final numeric coverage criterion; report evidence without claiming completion.
next_action: Authorize isolated author/reviewer roles, implement/test/freeze the evaluator before developer inspection of fresh cases, author/review/seal the cases, then execute once without tuning.
